rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying or doing something sarcastically.

example.english: You don't have to praise me sarcastically; I know I did well this time.
example.traditional: 你唔使串串貢咁讚我，我知自己今次考得好。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 cyun3 cyun3 gung3 gam3 zaan3 ngo5 ngo5 zi1 zi6 gei2 gam1 ci3 haau2 dak1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the sarcasm has an unpleasant, passive-aggressive, or deliberately odd tone.

example.english: They said sarcastically that I was really punctual, which made me even less willing to talk to them.
example.traditional: 佢陰陽怪氣咁話我真係好準時，搞到我更加唔想同佢傾。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jam1 joeng4 gwaai3 hei3 gam3 waa6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zeon2 si4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 gang3 gaa1 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 king1

rows.jyutping: ji5 fung3 ci3 ge3 hau2 man5
rows.note: Use this more formal phrase when describing a sarcastic tone, especially in writing or careful speech.

example.english: The commentary criticized the official's promises sarcastically.
example.traditional: 篇評論以諷刺嘅口吻批評嗰位官員嘅承諾。
example.jyutping: pin1 ping4 leon6 ji5 fung3 ci3 ge3 hau2 man5 pai1 ping4 go2 wai6 gun1 jyun4 ge3 sing4 nok6
